title: Orchestrate reported portfolio optimization
description:
As an account operator, I want a periodic optimization workflow to report findings, request exact approvals, and track approved work, so that useful improvements can proceed without unauthorized mutations.

Feature: Reported portfolio optimization run

Scenario: Analyze and request approval
  Given an account scope and frozen evidence window
  When the portfolio run completes exhaustive analysis
  Then the living report contains coverage, priorities, questions, and collection recommendations
  And incomplete evidence is never labeled exact
  And at most five exact targets are offered for independent approval

Scenario: Execute only current approvals
  Given a human approved selected targets and explicit limits
  When the workflow is ready to launch optimization
  Then champion, feedback, cooldown, configuration, and evidence preconditions are rechecked
  And only current approved targets are launched
  And evaluations are allowed to finish
  And no guideline, feedback setting, or champion is changed automatically

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started: adding an orchestration service that composes existing optimization decision packets with the durable run report, structured approval batches, freshness rechecks, and terminal review. Outside-in tests will cover report-first lifecycle, incomplete coverage stop, exact five-target approvals, stale launch rejection, fatal publication stop, and no automatic promotion.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the portfolio orchestration slice in the integration worktree: report-first lifecycle, complete-coverage stop, exact structured approvals in batches of five, freshness-preserving optimizer dispatch, terminal review without automatic promotion, and a Tactus procedure/runtime entrypoint. Focused runtime and orchestration specs are green; living-report artifact/stage hardening remains coordinated with its owning workstream.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Progress: default portfolio runtime validation now covers the zero-resource ChatMessage authority path. The next specification will reproduce missing authority as a fail-closed result, then verify advisory action create, deduplication, and response resolution occur only during portfolio run or replay without score or collection mutations.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Validation update: the reproduced default-runtime failure was caused by absent ChatMessage action authority in an injected report-only test and a misplaced runtime import. The contract now explicitly injects authority for success, covers the fail-closed missing-authority path, and verifies replay reuses and resolves the same advisory ChatMessage without operational mutations. Focused runtime, portfolio, HITL, chat, and procedure-config tests are green.
